Remark
[Variants of geodesic convexity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0440 1. apph:H.14\group Locally convex subsets A subset is convex when every minimizing ambient geodesic between two of its points stays in the subset; it is locally convex when this holds in a neighborhood of each point. Intersections of convex sets are convex, while locally convex sets need not be connected.
